findings.title: Secure Secret Generation
findings.evidence: Uses crypto.randomBytes(32) for HMAC secret generation during handshake.

findings.title: Elimination of Hardcoded Secrets
findings.evidence: Search for DEFAULT_SECP_AUTHORITY_SECRET returns zero results in production code.

findings.title: Fail-Closed Behavior Uninitialized
findings.evidence: computeHMACSealToken throws SIMULATION_AUTHORITY_NOT_INITIALIZED if state is UNINITIALIZED.

findings.title: Timing-Safe Comparison
findings.evidence: verifyHMACSealToken uses timingSafeEqual for tag verification.

findings.title: Key Versioning and Lifecycle
findings.evidence: Every handshake generates a unique timestamped key version string included in the HMAC payload.
